name: Overview: Checks findings from the Preview and the Product Kit

accessibility: Severity is carried by its word and its ink, never by color alone; each finding is a button that names what it opens.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Rail, NavItem, Button, Stack, Text, Icon, SegmentedControl, Segment, TabBar and TabBarItem); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog. The shell, the run line and the filters are those of Overview: Checks findings.

The tree is Stack rows, always expanded, one tree for each list a Variant shows; the strings of the app are copied under the same Locale keys, and the two kit findings' sentences are sample content (checks.sample.*).
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A member opened Overview › Checks after a run that listed Product Kit findings; the Preview sources have findings only while a View's Preview is open and reporting. The structure, translation and Catalog findings are in Overview: Checks findings.

The base state lists the Product Kit findings: a registry problem and the checks that repeat capture, compare a live render with a fresh one, and read props and emits. Variants list the Preview's translation warnings and its runtime errors.

The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; the Workbench chrome follows the Workbench language, so its text is baked here per Locale. Names, Widget ids, Variants and counts are sample content.
spec.intent: Show the findings of the two sources that do not come from reading the Workspace, as built from Adapter Widgets only: the Product Kit checks that a run starts on the server, and the translation warnings and runtime errors of the Preview that is open.
interactionRules: Product Kit findings are warnings and are grouped by the check that found them, except registry problems, which keep their own code; a finding names its component and Variant when the check does. They are never blocking: nothing here gates Preview, capture or Handoff.

The Preview's translation warnings are the three the Runtime reports for the Properties it evaluated: a key with no translation in the requested Locale (the fallback text is shown), a key the Locale files do not have (the key is shown) and an interpolation parameter that is missing; they are warnings and are grouped by warning code first.

The Preview's runtime errors are errors and say why the Preview failed: the View could not be loaded, the Adapters could not be used, the View uses Widgets the Adapters do not provide, the Preview is blocked, a Property failed to evaluate, the report was cut short, or any other error the Preview reported; each is shown only for the Preview, Variant and Locale that are open and never as a finding of an earlier one.

references.label: Phase 5 of the closed loop: dogfood coverage of the core surfaces
